overview.text: Soil_1_6 is a RiPP-like cluster identified solely by antiSMASH, spanning 10 kb on contig_1 from position 662,441 to 672,657 and containing 8 genes.

genes.text: antiSMASH marks 2 genes as biosynthetic (1 core and 1 additional) and 1 as transport.
CJLEIP_00553, annotated by Bakta as Type A2 lantipeptide, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH.
CJLEIP_00551 encodes Long-chain fatty acid--CoA ligase and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.

similar.text: The closest MIBiG entry is BGC0001555 (colicin V), from Escherichia coli chi7122.
antiSMASH's ClusterCompare gives this entry a score of 0.47 on a scale of 0 to 1, indicating a distant match.

hypothesis.text: The cluster may produce a lantipeptide with antibacterial activity, given the presence of a Type A2 lantipeptide core gene and associated secretion and transport genes, along with a hit to resistance models and similarity to a known antibacterial ribosomal peptide.

facts.sentence: Soil_1_6 is a RiPP-like cluster, found by antiSMASH only.
It spans 10 kb on contig_1 (662,441–672,657) and contains 8 genes.
antiSMASH marks 2 genes as biosynthetic (1 core and 1 additional) and 1 as transport.
antiSMASH names 1 core gene in the locus.
CJLEIP_00553, annotated by Bakta as Type A2 lantipeptide, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH.
CJLEIP_00551 encodes Long-chain fatty acid--CoA ligase and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.

Gene products in the locus, in genome order: CJLEIP_00549 VWFA domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_00550 Secreted protein; CJLEIP_00551 Long-chain fatty acid--CoA ligase; CJLEIP_00552 N-acetyltransferase; CJLEIP_00553 Type A2 lantipeptide; CJLEIP_00554 NHLP bacteriocin system secretion protein; CJLEIP_00555 NHLP family bacteriocin export ABC transporter peptidase/permease/ATPase subunit; CJLEIP_00556 NHLP bacteriocin export ABC transporter permease/ATPase subunit.
ARTS finds 1 hit to known resistance models.
The closest MIBiG entry is BGC0001555 (colicin V), from Escherichia coli chi7122.
antiSMASH's ClusterCompare gives this entry a score of 0.47 on a scale of 0 to 1. Overall this is a distant match.
MIBiG lists the compound class of BGC0001555 as ribosomal.
MIBiG records antibacterial activity for colicin V (BGC0001555).
MIBiG rates the annotation quality of BGC0001555 as questionable.
